title: Checks left out
summary: A check too slow for an editor is named, not dropped silently
prose: Open files run neither the checks too slow for an editor nor those unreliable on code being edited. clice names the slow ones the `.clang-tidy` enables once, with how to run them; `clice lint` runs every check.

at.$place: double ratio(int a, int b) { return ⟦a⟧ / b; }

diagnostics.message: result of integer division used in a floating point context; possible loss of precision

value: The clang-tidy configuration of ${WS}/main.cpp enables checks too slow for an editor, or not measured for one, which do not run on open files: misc-const-correctness. Set `clang_tidy_slow_checks = true` under `[diagnostics]` to run them, or `false` to leave them out without this message; `clice lint` runs them.
